summary: E2E tested Enterprise Network Defense Scanner feature end-to-end. Backend: 18/18 pytest tests pass covering the full verification lifecycle (submit -> pending_docs -> pending_company auto-transition in ~3s -> company-approve link -> pending_owner -> owner approve -> approved with 30d expiry and has_network_scan_permission=true -> revoke), owner list/detail/file-serve endpoints, network scanner (owner bypasses verification), real nmap scan of 127.0.0.1 completes in ~25s with hosts_total>=1 and graph.nodes>=1, JSON & PDF export, 403 gating for unverified user, regression on /api/scan/url and /api/scans/history. Frontend: Owner sees 'Network' nav link, /enterprise/network-scanner launches scan and navigates to result page, result page renders vis-network graph with node + 4 summary cards + PNG/PDF/JSON export (JSON download confirmed), /owner/verification lists requests and detail panel renders file View links + status badge (approve/reject/revoke buttons correctly conditional on status), /enterprise/verification submission form renders with all inputs. One minor React warning identified.

ui_bugs.issue: Input has both `value={form.submitted_email}` AND `defaultValue={user?.email}` props. React logs: 'contains an input of type with both value and defaultValue props. Input elements must be either controlled or uncontrolled'. Fix: drop defaultValue and instead initialize form state with user?.email in a useEffect so the field stays controlled.

design_issues.screen: Network Scan Result - Lateral Movement Graph
issues: Canvas2D console warning from vis-network: 'Multiple readback operations using getImageData are faster with the willReadFrequently attribute set to true.' Non-blocking; can be suppressed by setting { willReadFrequently: true } on the canvas context in vis-network config if you own the canvas wrapper, otherwise ignore.

action_items: (Optional, LOW) Remove `defaultValue={user?.email}` from the submitted_email Input in /app/frontend/src/pages/EnterpriseVerification.js (line 191) — either drop it (field already has value) or set form.submitted_email to user.email in a useEffect.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/enterprise.py _run_verification_pipeline: auto-transitions pending_docs -> pending_company even if face_match_passed is false. Consider branching to 'pending_owner_face_fail' or annotating warning for owner, so owner has explicit signal when face match < 0.75. Currently only the numeric face_match_score is surfaced.

routes/enterprise.py submit_verification: if any of the 3 files fails _safe_ext, the first saved file(s) are not cleaned up. Low risk (10MB cap) but consider wrapping all 3 _save_upload in a try/except that cleans partial writes.

OwnerVerification.js: action buttons are correctly conditional by status (pending_* => Approve/Reject; approved => Revoke) but there is NO affordance for 'rejected' or 'expired' records beyond read-only view. Consider adding a 'Re-open' or 'Clear history' action, or at least a muted status explainer badge.

network_scanner.py is real subprocess; verified nmap output is parsed correctly for 127.0.0.1. The service has no explicit timeout per host — a large CIDR will block the background task for minutes. Consider a max-scan-duration or chunked host scanning.

Backend /api/enterprise/start-scan rate-limit: 'max 1 active scan per user' uses a Mongo read-then-insert pattern that has a race window. For production, consider an upsert with a unique partial index on {user_id, status:{queued|running}} or a user-level mutex.
